text:
Type: low metal stool
Use: extra seating, perch, footrest; kitchen, dining room, hallway, workroom
Style: industrial, retro, farmhouse
Materials: beige powder-coated steel, round metal seat with a center hand hole, exposed bolts
Colors: pale beige, warm cream, silver bolt heads
Shape: round seat on four tubular legs that kick outward at the feet, square footrest ring, visible bolts, compact and sturdy
Feel: utilitarian, retro, casual
Goes with: white tiles, butcher-block wood, enamel and cream tones; industrial, farmhouse or retro kitchens
